method: Point-in-time safety-intent routing from public SERP snippets, official project pages, and machine-readable release snapshots. This file is not an antivirus scan, malware verdict, file reputation verdict, or endorsement of any download host.

summary.recommendedFirstMove: Match source identity before opening or replacing files.
summary.notEnoughEvidence: A copied filename, high download count, Google Play description, Discord attachment, Drive link, Vercel landing page, or Reddit comment is not enough to prove a Verity file is safe.
separateChecks: hash comparison when published by the source
local antivirus or sandbox scan when malware risk is the question

routes.question: Is Verity Mod a virus?
routes.safeAnswer: This site cannot declare every file with that name safe or malicious. The useful first answer is whether the page points to a traceable route such as Verity JE, Verity BE, PnTMC, MCPEDL, VERITY.exe, or an unrelated app.
avoid: asking strangers for a taken-down file
opening password archives or EXE installers that claim to be a Minecraft add-on
pasting API keys into download pages
treating a copied filename as a safety verdict

routes.question: The browser says the Verity JAR might harm my device.
routes.safeAnswer: Java JARs are executable code, so browser warnings are expected on many downloads. Do not dismiss the warning; first match the maintainer route, file record, file name, loader, and publisher hash if available.

routes.question: Is the Vercel Verity v2.6 page safe?
routes.safeAnswer: Treat it as unverified until it exposes a matching Modrinth or CurseForge project ID, file record, version ID, checksum, and maintainer account.

routes.question: Is a Google Play Verity app the official add-on?
routes.safeAnswer: A Google Play app can be a third-party helper or content app. It is not automatically the same as a maintainer MCADDON, JAR, MRPACK, or CurseForge/Modrinth record.

routes.question: Is MCPEDL safe for Verity Bedrock?
routes.safeAnswer: Use MCPEDL as a discovery page, then match the current PnTMC row to a CurseForge file record before importing the MCADDON.

routes.question: Someone posted an old Drive, Discord, MediaFire, or Mega link.
routes.safeAnswer: Treat old direct-file links as source-proof problems. A current route should be rebuilt from a maintainer-controlled page, not from a copied attachment.
